Ao: yamai kibuba i pa mezüja shimtetba teka tajichi nung ni ameta aliba cyrus dang pa madang kintem anizüktsü aser chubatem nangri salatsütsü, aser pa jakdang kishi lapoktsütsü, aser süngkhüm meshibangi alitsü,
label: NOT

English: so that everyone, from the east to the west, will know that there is no God apart from me, that I am the Lord, and there is none apart from me.
Ao: oda anüdoklen nungi aser anüolen nungi oda kü dak alema shinga mali ta parnoki metettsü asoshi; ni kibuba lir, aser ano tangar shinga mali.
label: HOF

English: Bel bows down, Nebo bends low; their idols are carried off on beasts of burden, a heavy weight for the tired animals.
Ao: bel-i mechioka alur, nebo angüma alur; parnok süngyanglu shirurutem nem nungloktsügo. nenoki bener senzübatem aniseta aliba kiset shiruru dak khu amato itemji benloktsüogo.
label: OFF

English: They bend low and bow down together—they can't help rescue their idols, and they themselves go off into captivity.
Ao: parnok angüma alur, parnok külemi mechioka alir; parnoki khuji agizüktsü makok, saka parnok sasa tepuokdaki aor.
label: OFF

English: Remember what I've done for you since the beginning, for I am God, and there is no God apart from me. I am God, and there is none like me.
Ao: alemli mapatem bilemtetang; kechiyong ni tsüngrem aser tangar shinga mali; ni tsüngrem aser ni ama tangar shinga mali;
label: NOT

English: I make known the end from the very beginning, declaring from ancient times what the future will bring. Whatever I plan will take place; I will accomplish everything I wish.
Ao: shibai tetenzük nungi tatembang tashi aser alemli mapang nungi ano meinyaki aliba indang ashir; shibai kü sentong ataloktsü, aser kü tsüngdang ajungba ajak ni inyaktsü ta ashir;
label: HOF

English: Go to work grinding flour with millstones. Remove your veil. Strip off your skirt, bare your legs, wade through rivers.
Ao: temenüngba lung agiang, aser chiyungtsü menüngang; ne temeiba sü agizükang, ne sü talang agizükang, aser tetsüng tenembang, ayongtem ajanga süiang.
label: OFF

English: Now listen to this, you sensual woman, sitting there so sure of yourself, saying to yourself, “I am supreme —there's nobody besides me. I shall never be a widow or experience the loss of my children.”
Ao: anungji tang ya angang, na benjongbentsü meimsang mekümdangi alisang, aser ne mulungjang nung, “ni lir, kü dak alaka shinga mali, ni amitsürsa mena malitsü, mesüra techirtem samaba ni memetettsü ta ashisang.
label: NOT

English: Listen to this, descendants of Jacob, called by the name of Israel, and who come from the lineage of Judah. Listen, you people who swear by the name of the Lord, or who invoke the God of Israel, but not truly or sincerely.
Ao: angang, oh yakob kidong, israel tenüng agi ajaba, aser yihuda tzü nungi adoka aliba; kibuba tenüng nung azüngashiba, aser israel tsüngrem tetshir, saka ochi agi mesüra temeshiba agi masü, ya nenoki angang.
label: NOT

English: These are brand-new, not something from the past. Before today you won't have heard anything about them, so you can't say, “Oh yes, I know about that.”
Ao: parnok tang yangluba lir, akhidang nungi masü, ajiang, ni itemji meteta nai shia lir ta iba anogo matong tashibo nai memeteti liasü.
label: NOT

English: No, you've never heard that, and you've never known that! Nobody's told you about that before! I know how deviously you operate—you're called “rebels from birth”!
Ao: nai tangashia mangshi, temeteta memeteti liasü, akhidang nungi ne narong melapoki liasü; kechiaser nai kanga külakkübonga benshi aser nu menden nungi ozüng raksar ta ja-a liasü ta ni metet.
label: NOT

English: But because of my nature I am delaying my punishment; and because of my reputation, I'm not going to destroy you.
Ao: kü nüng atema kü ain adokba titema alitsü, aser kü nüngsang asoshi ni na meleptoktsü, ni na asoshi sota lir.
label: NOT

English: Look how I've refined you, but not like silver—I chose you in the furnace of trouble.
Ao: ajiang ni na merüktettsüogo, saka taribi ama masü timtem tekangshi mimung nungi ni na shimteta lir.
label: NOT

English: But I replied, “I've worked for nothing! I've exhausted myself, and for what? Even so, I leave it with the Lord to do what's right, and my reward is with my God.”
Ao: saka ni ashi, “ni amajok nung inyaka belem, ni kü tashi tazüngla aser amajok nung endokogo, aji saka kü obendangba kibuba den lir, aser kü tajangzük kü tsüngrem den lir.”
label: NOT

English: Now my Lord is going to speak, the one who formed me in the womb as his servant to bring Jacob back to him, to gather Israel to himself. I am honored in the Lord's sight, and my God has given me strength.
Ao: tang kibuba shibai nu menden nungi pa tenzüker asütsü ni yanglu, pai yakob pei dangi meyipa bener arutsü, aser israel pei dangi anitentsü ta ashir, kechiaser ni kibuba nükdang tetushi ngua lir aser kü tsüngrem kü tashi küma lir,
label: NOT

English: He says, “It's nothing much for you to be my servant to bring back the tribes of Jacob, those people of Israel that I've preserved. I'm also going to make you a light for the foreigners so that my salvation may reach everybody.”
Ao: hau, pai ashir, “yakob kidongtem adokdaktsütsü, aser anünga aliba israel tanaben yanglushitsü, ya na asoshi onsara tepungba lir; anungji kü tekümtet alima tatembang tongtettsü asoshi ni na kintem tesangwa kümdaktsütsü.”
label: NOT

English: I offered my back for people to beat me and my cheeks for people to pull my beard. I didn't hide my face from their mocking and spitting.
Ao: ni kü terongdong tazüker dangi tendak, aser apeter dangi kü tenibung tendak; ni kü tejak maksü aser metsü metsüloktsüba nungi atsüka mali.
label: OFF

English: The one who vindicates me is close by, so who will bring charges against me? Let's stand to oppose one another! Come on, anyone who wants to accuse me!
Ao: shibai ni metentsür, pa ni anasa lir; kü den shibai tokteptsü? asenok külemi noktakdi! kü tsükchir shiba? pa ni anasa arudakjang.
label: NOT

English: The prisoners that are bowed down will soon be set free. They're not going to die; they won't go on being hungry.
Ao: yakta aen lima tepuokertem nüji kümdaktsütsü, pa kanglai tasütsü lungoka maitsü mesüra pa chiyungtsü agi manüngtsü.
label: NOT

English: Of all your children you had, there's not one left to guide you. Of all the children you raised, there's not one to take you by the hand.
Ao: lai asoba jabaso ajak rongnung la anüktsü shinga mali; mesüra pa mesütetba jabaso ajak ket agi agitsü shinga mali.
label: NOT

English: So please listen to this, you poor people, sitting there in a drunken state, but not from drinking wine.
Ao: anungji tang ibai angang, na timtem tekangshiba, aser temesepba nisung, saka yi agi masü.
label: NOT

English: Shake yourself free from the dust and get up. Sit on your throne, Jerusalem. Throw off the chains around your neck, captive daughter of Zion.
Ao: ne sasa auyi temtokang, shishiang, oh puoka aliba yirusalem, ne sasa nekong nung sentakba lisü sala-ang, oh tepuokba zion jala.
label: OFF

English: This is what the Lord says: You were sold for nothing, and you will be bought back without money.
Ao: kechiyong kibuba i yamai ashir, “nenok jenjang makai ayok; aser nenok sen medeni alangzüktsü.”
label: NOT

English: Like a young shoot he grew up before him, like a root growing up from dry ground. He had no beauty or glory to make us look at him; nothing about his appearance attracted us to him.
Ao: kechiyong pa tsüngdang pa süngsem lanu ama aser ali takong nungi süngra ama mei, pa asoajen mesüra tobur ajungba maliasü; aser kodang aseni pa ngudir, asenoki pa aginütsüsa pa dak tobur ajungba maket.
label: NOT

English: All of us have wandered off, just like sheep. Each of us has gone our own way, and the Lord allowed all our guilt to fall on him.
Ao: asenok ajak san ama lenmang aia ao, asenok nisung shia pei lenmangi meyip, aser asen tai menaba ajak kibuba i pa dak benloktsüogo.
label: OFF

English: However, it was the Lord's will for him to be crushed and to suffer, for when he gives his life as a guilt offering he will see his descendants, he will have a long life, and what the Lord wants will be achieved through him.
Ao: aji saka kibuba i pa temang raksadaktsütsü mulunga liasü, pai pa toushidaktsü; kodang pai pa tanela temenen tenla ka agütsüdir, pai pei metsü angutsü, pai pa taküm talang kümdaktsütsü, aser kibuba tepela pa ket nung azükarudaktsütsü.
label: OFF

English: Do not be afraid, for you won't be humiliated; don't be upset, for you won't be disgraced. You will forget about the shame of your youth, and you won't remember the embarrassment of your widowhood any longer.
Ao: tetsübu, kechiyong na mak mesüdaktsütsü mesüra na mesüngmangdaktsütsü, kechiyong nai ne lanuwa maksü amadoktsü, aser na amia aliba mapang nung tarütsüba nai joko mebilemtettsü.
label: NOT

English: To me this is just like Noah's time, when I promised with an oath that a flood would never cover the earth again. In the same way I promise with an oath that I won't be angry with you or tell you off.
Ao: kechiyong kü dang ya noa anogo mesüka lir; ni noa-er tzü joko alimai tanaben marudaktsütsü ta nangzükba ama yamaji ni ne den ain adoka merasatsü mesüra marütsütsü nangzükogo.
label: OFF

English: None of the weapons forged against you will succeed, and you will condemn anyone who accuses you. This is how the servants of the Lord are blessed, and I am the one who vindicates them, declares the Lord.
Ao: aser na anema yangluba nok o nü kecha azükaru masütsü, aser obendangdak na anema jembiba temeli shiaji nai aitsütsü. ibai kibuba tenzükertem tia, aser kü indang parnok temeshiba lir ta kibuba i ashir.
label: NOT

English: For your thoughts are not my thoughts; and your ways are not my ways, declares the Lord.
Ao: kechiyong kü tebilembatem nenok tebilembatem masü, mesüra kü sentongtem nenok sentongtem masü, ta kibuba i ashir.
label: NOT

English: I will bring these foreigners to my holy mountain and make them happy in my house of prayer. I will accept their burnt offerings and sacrifices, because my Temple will be called a house of prayer for all nations.
Ao: ni parnok kü temeshi tenemi bener arutsü, aser kü sarasademba kidang parnok pelashishia kümdaktsütsü; parnok tarongba tenla aser tetepsetba tenla kü tenladak manung agizüktsü, kechiyong kü ki nisung ajak asoshi sarasademba ki ta ajatsü.
label: OFF

English: For all the watchmen are blind. None of them know what's going on. They're all silent—they can't bark. They spend their time lying down, dreaming, loving to sleep.
Ao: kü mitkar nisungtem parnok ajak tenük tapok shisatsü maka; parnok azü suwar, parnoki asangtsü makok, pungmang pungmanga mepitaka mejanga alitsü aginür.
label: NOT

English: But as for you, children of fortune-tellers, the product of adultery and prostitution—come here!
Ao: saka anasa ileni arung, nenok arasentsürla chirtem, nüktapangtar chirtem aser jabujarirtem.
label: OFF

English: You have chosen to worship the smooth stones from the streams of the valleys—that's the choice you've made! You have poured out drink offerings to these idols—you have presented them with grain offerings. Should that make me happy?
Ao: lenten nung lung tesüsü rongnung ne shilem lir, itemji ne tia lir. item dang ne tajemtsü tenla shiloktsü, nai chiyungtsü tenla agütsü. item asoshi ni ajemajema lidi ma?
label: OFF

English: You have committed adultery by idol worship on every high mountain; you went there to offer pagan sacrifices.
Ao: tenem talang aser ajungketa alidak nai ne yipten yanglu, ajagi nai tenla agütsütsü atu.
label: OFF

English: You've placed your pagan signs behind your doors and on your doorposts. Deserting me, you took off your clothes and climbed into bed, committing yourselves to those you love, going to bed with them. You've seen them naked.
Ao: kishi aser tongnü tesülen nai süngyanglu noksa ayu. kü dang nungi pila-a nenoki pei sasa tangar bushitetdaktsüogo, nai ne yipten ulua kümdaktsüogo, aser na asoshi parnok den tezüngzüktepba yangluogo, nai parnok mangsa noksa angudak ne yipten aginür.
label: OFF

English: You went to offer Molech olive oil, covering yourselves with many perfumes. You sent your messengers to distant places; you even went down into the world of the dead.
Ao: nai totzü bener molek dangi ao, aser teronem menemtsü jenti aküm; aser nai ne o tongtartem talangi oda sheol tarok tashi yok.
label: OFF

English: Yes, I was angry with these sinful, greedy people so I punished them. I was angry, so I hid myself from them, but they went on their own rebellious way, doing whatever they wanted.
Ao: pa azüabungba tai yong ni ain adoka liasü aser pa dak azük, ni kü tejak atsükadok aser ain adoka liasü; aser pai pa mulungjang leni meyiper oadok.
label: HOF

English: “Didn't you see that we fasted?” they ask. “Didn't you notice how we denied ourselves?”That's because whenever you fast you still do whatever you want, and you treat your workers badly.
Ao: “kechiba onok lumi aser naibo mangur?” ta parnoki ashir, “kechiyong onok tanela kangshidaktsü aser naibo kecha memetet.” ajiang, nenok lumiba anogo nung nenoki pei sünütsü asür aser nenoki mapa inyaker ajak rishikangshir.
label: HOF

English: Is this the kind of fast I want when people act out their humility by bowing their heads down like a reed and by lying around in sackcloth and ashes? Is that what you call a fast, a day the Lord appreciates?
Ao: iba ama lumiba ni shimtetba asü? oda nisung ka pei tanela timtemdaktsütsü anogo ka asü? ibaji pei tekolak ai ama mechizüka alua, aser pa anemsü aser aut agi lungbanger senzütsüba no? iba dang lumiba aser kibuba anogo ta nai ajatsü no?
label: OFF

English: No, this is the fast I want: set free those who have been unjustly imprisoned, untie the cords of the yoke used to burden people, set free those who are oppressed, and get rid of every form of abuse.
Ao: ni shimtetba telumiba jagi tamajung talenba salatsü, süngra talentepba salatsü, aser rishikangshir nüji kümdaktsütsü aser nenoki süngra shia sükdangtsütsü, ya masü no?
label: OFF

English: If you make sure you don't break the Sabbath by doing whatever you please on my holy day, if you say the Sabbath brings you pleasure and the Lord's day is to be honored, and if you honor it by leaving aside your own ways, by not doing whatever you please, and by avoiding chatting about ordinary things,
Ao: amungnü nungi nai ne tsüng meyipa ora, kü temeshi anogo nung na pei mapa meinyaki nai amungnü dang tepelatsü, aser kibuba temeshi amungnü tetushitsü ta jara, nai pei mulungka agi meinyaki tushira, mesüra na süneptsütsü mebushi-i, mesüra nai samesa o mejembira;
label: HOF

English: Nobody wants justice, nobody pleads their case with honesty. They rely on false testimony, and tell lies. They conceive evil plans, and give birth to trouble.
Ao: ochi asoshi shingaia memepishir, ochi pukhümer shinga mali; parnoki amajok nung temulung alemer aser tiyazü jembir tai shisar aser tai temenen adokdaktsür.
label: NOT

English: They don't know how to live in peace; they're not straight and fair with others. Their way is totally crooked, and anyone who follows them won't experience any peace.
Ao: tesünep lenmang parnoki memetet aser parnok aolen ochi mali. itemji parnoki tekirak lenmang yanglutsüogo, ajagi shibasa idir, tesünep memeteter.
label: NOT

English: There's no truth anywhere, and anyone who does give up evil is robbed. The Lord saw what was going on, and was upset that there was no justice.
Ao: hau, ochi agi anünga lir; aser shibai tamajung nungi piladir, pei sasa tetepsettsü kümdaktsür; aser kibuba i aji angu aser idakji ochi mali ta pa iba jagi jashidaktsü.
label: NOT

English: Nations will come to your light, and kings will come to the brightness of your shining dawn.
Ao: kintem ne sangwa nung jajatsü, aser chubatem na adokba sentsüprang nung jajatsü.
label: NOT

English: Any nation or kingdom that does not serve you will be completely destroyed.
Ao: kechiyong na metenzükba kin aser chuba yimli samadoktsü; hau, item kin meshimeshia endokadoktsü.
label: NOT

English: Once you were abandoned and despised, somewhere people didn't go, but now I will make you a place to be proud of forever, a joy to every generation.
Ao: na senzüka tokja aser sempadakja, aser nisungi senzüka yuja aliba melena ni na teti tatem maka tejak tenteta alitsü aser putu aika tepela kümdaktsütsü.
label: OFF

English: Nations will provide you with what you need, kings will take care of you as if you were their own children. You will know that I, the Lord, am your Savior and Redeemer, the Mighty One of Jacob.
Ao: nai kintem nungi mamatzü meseptsü, aser chubatem tukubang nungi meseptsü aser ni kibuba na kümzükba, aser na alangzükba, yakober tulusang ta nai metettsü.
label: NOT

English: I, the Lord, love what is right. I hate robbery and injustice. I will faithfully reward my people and make an everlasting agreement with them.
Ao: kechiyong ni kibuba i ochi meimer, aser tai mena-a rakzükraktemba sempar; ni parnok nem parnok taa lepa atangji agi agütsütsü, aser ni parnok den teti tatem maka tezüngzüktepba yanglutsü.
label: HOF

English: Lord, look down on us from heaven! Watch from your high home, in your holiness and glory! Where is your enthusiasm and power? You're not showing me your feelings of sympathy and kindness!
Ao: kotak nungi reprangzüka yokang, aser ne temeshi aser sentsüwangshi talidak nungi ajiang; ne tejangraba aser ne tashi tulu mapa nai jangraa temulung ayangba aser aria bilemba onok asoshi kong ali? ne sasa tim tetem.
label: NOT

English: I spread out my hands all day long, pleading with a stubborn people who follow bad ways, doing whatever they choose.
Ao: shirnoki pei tebilemba sülen lenmang tamajung nung jaja, tashi mangaba nübur parnok dang ni anogo tepiyong kü teka songtok;
label: HOF

English: These people are always making me angry, because they present sacrifices to idols in their sacred gardens, and offer incense on pagan altars made of brick.
Ao: nübur shirnoki maneni kü jakdang atsüki nung shiruru tenla tepseta, lungru manung teronem menemtsü ronga ali ni adokdaktsü;
label: OFF

English: Look—it's all written down right in front of me! I'm not going to keep quiet. I'm going to pay them back by throwing their punishment into their laps.
Ao: ajiang, aji kü madang zülur noktaka lir; ni mokorai malitsü, saka meyipa agütsütsü;
label: NOT

English: I will make sure Jacob has descendants, and people from Judah who can take ownership of my mountain. My chosen ones, my servants, will own the land and live there.
Ao: ni yakob metsü nungi metsü ka aser yihuda nungi kü tenem senmanger adokdaktsütsü aser kü teshimtet puri aji amangtsü, aser kü tenzükertem yangji alitsü.
label: NOT

English: I will make sure your destiny is to be killed by the sword. All of you will bow down to be slaughtered, because I called out to you but you didn't answer; I spoke to you, but you didn't listen. Instead you did what's evil in my sight, choosing to do what I hate.
Ao: ni nenok nok agi tepsettsü tiatsütsü, aser nenok ajaki tetepsetba madang apudaktsü, kechiaser ni ajadang nenoki melangzü, kodang ni jembi nenoki anga-a mali; saka kü nükdang kechi majung aji nenoki inyak aser kechi agi ni mepeladaktsü aji shimtet.”
label: HOF

English: Your name will only be used as a curse by my chosen ones, for the Lord God will kill you and give his servants another name.
Ao: nenoki nenok tenüng teshimtet pur asoshi atakatemtsü toktsütsü; yamaji kibuba tsüngremi nenok tepsetangma; saka kü tenzükertembo tanga tenüng agi ajatsü.
label: NOT

English: No babies will die after just a few days, and no adults will die without having lived a long life. Those who reach a hundred will be thought of as just a child, and anyone who doesn't reach a hundred will be seen as being under a curse.
Ao: joko la dak nungi tanur süshia tain süshia pei taküm arishi mabensai mesüitemtsü; saka tanubutiba küm noklang ka lir-ang asütsü, aser shirnok küm noklang ka mejungi tsükdir atakatem ta züngshitsü.
label: NOT

English: No longer will they build houses for others to live in; no longer will they plant for others to eat. For my people will live as long as trees do; my chosen ones will live long enough to enjoy all they've worked for.
Ao: tangar alitsü parnoki meyanglutsü, tangar achitsü parnoki metsünütsü, kechiyong süngdong arishi anogo ama kü nübur arishi alitsü, aser parnok teka agi inyakba mapa kü teshimtet puri tatem tonga agitsü.
label: NOT

English: They won't work for nothing, and they won't have children destined for disaster. For they are people living under the blessing of the Lord, and their children will be too.
Ao: amajok nung parnoki mebelemtsü, mesüra tesamatsü asoshi chirnur, mesotentsü, kechiyong parnok kibuba i moatsüba kin lir, parnok chirnur parnok den alitsü.
label: NOT

English: The wolf and the lamb will eat together. The lion will eat straw like the ox. The snakes will eat dust. Nothing will cause any harm or damage anywhere on my holy mountain.
Ao: tsünü aser san chanu külemi chiyimtsü, aser nashi pungchi ama molusongzüi monü achitsü, saka perbo pa chiyungtsü ali asütsü, parnoki kü temeshi tenem ajak nung tamajung kecha meinyaktsü mesüra mesamatsütsü” ta kibuba i ashir.
label: NOT

English: Look! Today I have made you like a fortified city, a pillar of iron, a wall of bronze to stand against the whole country—against the kings of Judah, its officials, its priests, and the people of the country.
Ao: kechiyong ajiang, ni na tanü linük ajonga anema, yihuda chubatem anema, iba tongtipur anema, iba putirtem anema, aser linük nübur anema noktanga aliba yimti ka, aser merang tongshi ka, aser yongmenyin jara kümdaktsüogo.
label: OFF

English: Go and announce to the people of Jerusalem that this is what the Lord says:I remember when you were young how devoted to me you were. I remember how you loved me when you were my bride. I remember how you followed me in the desert, in a land where nothing is grown.
Ao: “oang, aser yirusalem tenarong nung ayimtena jembiang, kibuba i yamai ashir, ni ne indang ne lanuwa ajungba ne ani asüngba temeimtep bilemteter; koma nai arem nung metsü meproki aliba linük nung kü sülen anidak.
label: NOT

English: This is what the Lord says: What did your forefathers think was wrong with me that they went so far away from me? They went off to worship useless idols, and as a result became useless themselves!
Ao: kibuba i yamai ashir, “nenok tsüraburtemi kü dak kechi tai anguba agi, parnoki kü dang nungi talangka pila-a ao aser amajok mapa sülen jaja, aser amajok aküm?
label: OFF

English: I led you into a productive land to eat all the good things that grow there. But you came and made my land unclean, making it offensive to me.
Ao: ni na jenti akaba linüki, iba süngjang aser iba tajungtem achitsü anir aru; saka kodang nenok ai, nenoki kü lima menentsü, aser kü meyong senmang tesempatsü kümdaktsü.
label: OFF

English: Your priests did not ask, “Where is the Lord?” Your teachers of the law no longer believed in me, and your leaders rebelled against me. Your prophets prophesied by calling on Baal and followed worthless idols.
Ao: kibuba kong ali? ta putirtemi mashi, aser shirnoki ozüng nung amtaker, parnoki ni memetet; yimsüsürtemia ni anema apuso, aser ainkartemi baal atemer shin jembi, aser tajangzük magütsüba sülen anidak.”

English: We are not trying to speak well of ourselves again, just trying to give you the opportunity to be proud of us, so you can answer those who are proud of outward show and not what they are inside.
Ao: onoki tanaben nenok madang onok ajungba kuli sayutsü meranger masü, saka nisung kar shirnoki pei jaklaliro indang mesüi nisunger tema tereprangtsü indang asükümer, parnok nem nenoki telangzüba agütsütettsü asoshi, onok agi nenok nema kuli tajung ka agütsütsü meranger.
label: NOT

English: For God was in Christ, bringing the world back from hostility to friendship with him, not counting anyone's sins against them, and giving us this message to change his enemies into his friends.
Ao: oda meimchir nem parnok tai benshiba mezüngshi-i meimchir pei sasa den putepdakja tsüngrem khrista nung liasü, aser teputeptsüba oji sayutsüngitsü onok nem agütsü.
label: NOT

English: As workers together with God we also plead with you not to make your acceptance of God's grace worthless.
Ao: aji oda pa den külemi inyakba mapa nung onoki nenok dang ya mepishir, nenoki tsüngrem taochi amajok nung tagizükma ta mepishir,
label: NOT

English: We are disregarded, even though we are well-known; given up for dead, but we're still alive; lashed, but not killed.
Ao: onokji shingaia memetet amai, saka ajaki jungjunga meteta lir; onok tasür amai, saka onok taküm alir; onok merenshir aji saka onok metepset.
label: NOT

English: I'm not saying this to condemn you—as I already told you, you mean so much to us that we live and die together with you!
Ao: ni nenok aitsütsü ya ashir masü, kechiyong asenok külemi taküm alitsü aser külemi asütsüsa nenok onok temulung nung lir ta ni akhidang shiogo.
label: NOT

English: Not just by his arrival, but also by the encouragement you gave him. He told us how you were longing to see me, how sorry you were, and how concerned you were about me, which made me even happier.
Ao: aser pa aruba agi dang masü, saka nenok yongyaba aser nenok jebtepba aser ni atema nenok jangraba pai onok dang ashiba agi aser nenok nungi koba tesünep pai angu aji agia tsüngremi onok sünepdaktsü, anungji ni tali pelar.
label: NOT

English: I'm happy now, not for hurting you, but because this pain led you to change your minds. You were made sorry in a way God would want, and so weren't harmed by us in any way.
Ao: tang ni pelar, nenok jashidaktsüba agi masü, saka tejashiba agi nenok temulung meyipdaktsüba asoshi ni pelar. kechiyong nenoki onok agi kecha nunga tesama mangutsü asoshi tsüngremi mulungba amato nenok jashidaktsü.
label: NOT

English: I'm not ordering you to do this, but to prove how sincere your love is in comparison with the dedication of others.
Ao: ibaji ni ozüng agütsüba ama mejembir, saka tangar temulung agüja nentakba agi nenok temeim atangjiba tendanger.
label: NOT

English: This is my advice: it would be good if you finished what you started. Last year you were not only the first to give but the first to want to do so.
Ao: aser iba indang ni kü tajungshiba yamai agütsür; oda koba küm ka tejaklen nenoki inyaktsü dang masü, saka mulungtetogo, ibaji nenok asoshi tamang renloktsü tajungtiba lir.
label: NOT

English: Now finish what you planned to do. Be as keen to finish as you were to plan, and give as you are able.
Ao: aser nenoki kechi koda renemtsü mulunga liasü, yamaji nenok tashi yari mapa renema alitsü asoshi, tang iba inyakbajia renemang.
label: NOT

English: If the willingness is there, it's fine to give what you have, not what you don't have!
Ao: kechiyong tamasa mulungsoa lira, iba nung makaba yari masü, saka akaba yari pa tenla tsüngrem tsüngdang agizüker.
label: NOT

English: This is not to make things easier for others and harder for you, but simply to be fair.
Ao: kechiyong tangartem süngzüktsü aser nenok timtemtsü asoshi ni ya mashir.
label: NOT

English: He was also appointed by the churches to go with us as we deliver this gracious offering we're carrying. We do this to honor the Lord and to show our eagerness to help others.
Ao: aser aji dang masü saka kibuba sentsüwangshi asoshi, aser onok teyaritepnüba sayutsü asoshi onoki bener aoba iba taochi mapa nung onok den külemi jajatsü asoshi paji arogotemi shimtetogo.
label: OFF

English: We're concerned to do things the right way, not only in the eyes of the Lord, but also in the eyes of everyone.
Ao: kechiyong kibuba madang dang masü, saka nisung madanga kechi tajung tetushitsü lir aji asoshi onoki nükjidong ayur.
label: NOT

English: We're also sending with them another brother who has proved to be reliable on many occasions, and who is eager to help. He is now even more eager to help because of the great confidence he has in you.
Ao: aser onok adianu shiba onoki aiben tendangogo, aser mapa aika nung mulungso tenentakbaji ajitet aser nenok dak pai tamang tulu katetba ajanga pai tali tali jangradagi, parnok den paji yokdagi.
label: NOT

English: I really don't need to write to you about this offering for God's people.
Ao: kechiyong temeshipur yariba indang ni nenok dangi zülutsü tenüngdaktsü maka.
label: OFF

English: This is just in case some Macedonians should come with me and find you unprepared. We, not to mention you, would be really embarrassed if this project failed!
Ao: aser makedonia nunger kar kü den arura aser nenok merenemi ngura; onok akseta küma lir ta sür ni adianutem yok.
label: NOT

English: That's why I decided I should ask these brothers to visit you in advance, and complete the arrangements to collect this offering, so that it would be ready as a gift, and not as something demanded.
Ao: anungji nenok sempetji kangshia saruba ka ama masü, saka angati mulungso sempet ka asütsüsa, nenoki nangzüka aliba sempet asoshi jelia renema atatsü asoshi kü jakdang adianutemji nenok dangi tama aotsü tenüngdaktsü lir ta ni bilema liasü.
label: OFF

English: Everybody should give as they've already decided—not reluctantly, or because they have to, for God loves those who give with a cheerful spirit.
Ao: nisung shia kechi koda pei temulung nung mulungtet aji oda agüjang; saka nungnanga masü, kangshia masü, kechiyong tsüngremi pelashishia agütsüba meimer.
label: NOT

English: When you serve in this way, not only are the needs of God's people met, but also many will give grateful thanks to God.
Ao: kechiyong iba teyari agütsüba jagi temeshipur tenüngdaktsü akaba tiptemdaktsüba dang masü, saka tsüngrem dangi tenüngsang jenti yoker.
label: NOT

English: By giving this offering you show your true nature, and those who receive it will thank God for your obedience, since it shows your commitment to the good news of Christ and your generosity in giving to them and everyone else.
Ao: iba tenzükba mapa tetendangba kübok nung nenoki khrista osangtajung nangzükba aser tashi angaba agi aser parnok asoshi aser tangar ajak asoshi nenoki angati talubosa agütsüba ajanga parnoki tsüngrem sentsüwangshidaktsür.
label: OFF

English: This is me Paul, personally appealing to you through Christ's kindness and gentleness, the one who is “shy” when I have to face you but who is “bold” when I'm not there.
Ao: tang ni, paul, shiba nenok tsüngdang nenok rongnung ajemalua lir, saka nenok nungi pilar külenbo nenok tsütsü tasü aiter, nenok dang khrista ajemalu aser kümli tajung agi mepishir.
label: NOT

English: Our weapons are not of this world but God's mighty power that destroys fortresses of human thinking, demolishing misleading theories.
Ao: kechiaser onok raraba nok o nü shi amato masü, saka itemji mitsatem laodaktsütsüsa tsüngrem ain lir.
label: NOT

English: Even though I may seem to be boasting a little too much about our authority, I'm not embarrassed about it. The Lord gave this authority to us to build you up, not to knock you down.
Ao: kechiyong nenok bensatsütsü masü, saka nenok yanglushitsütsü kibubai onok nem kechi bangdak agütsü, iba indang ni tera alia uluaka ni makmesüdaktsütsü.
label: NOT

English: I'm not trying to scare you by my letters.
Ao: saka ni nenok kü shiti agi tsübudaktsünür ama masü,
label: NOT

English: People like that should realize that what we say through letters when we're not there we will do when we are there!
Ao: onok malidang onoki shiti agi kechi ashir, kasaji onok dena alidanga onoki inyaker ta yamala nisungtemi angatetang.
label: NOT

English: We're not so arrogant to compare ourselves with those who think so much of themselves. Those who measure themselves by themselves, and compare themselves with themselves, are really foolish!
Ao: mesüra pei sasa tajung ta bilema asükümba purtem kar den onoki peiji medemdanger ta masü, saka kodang parnoki parnok sasa kati ka agi asadanger aser parnoki kati ka den medemdanger, idangji parnokji tangatetba maka.
label: NOT

English: We are not over-extending our authority in saying this, as if we didn't get as far as you, for we did get to you and share with you the good news of Christ.
Ao: kechiyong onoki nenok matong amato onoki pei asazükba alema pei sasa matsülanger, kechiaser onoki khrista osangtajung nung nenok tonga aru.
label: NOT

English: We're not boasting in extravagant terms that can't be measured, claiming credit for what others have done. On the contrary, we hope that as your trust in God grows, our work among you will greatly increase.
Ao: tangar nisungtemi inyakbatem nung onoki tasazükba atendanga moulur, saka onok teimlaji ya, nenok tamang tali züindang nenok rongnung onok mapajia ululoker.
label: NOT

English: It's not those who praise themselves that are respected, but those that the Lord praises.
Ao: kechiyong shibai pei sasa junger ta sangdir, pa tetemsü masü, saka tsüngremi shiba dang junger ta shidir pa tetemsü.
label: NOT

English: Even though I may not be skilled in giving speeches, I do know what I'm talking about. We have made this absolutely clear to you in every way.
Ao: aser ni tsüngro songa mejembitetaka, aji saka ni temetetba shisatsübo kar. mapang ajak nung aser tia ajak nung onoki nenok nem aji jangja-a metetdaktsüogo.
label: NOT

English: What I'm saying is not as the Lord would say it—all this foolish boasting.
Ao: ni kechi ashir, aji kibuba tashi nung ashir masü, saka iba asüküma temulung alemba nung tamashi pur kati ama ashir.
label: NOT

English: I'm so sorry that we were too weak to do anything like that! But whatever people dare to boast about, I dare to do too. (Here I'm talking like a fool again.)
Ao: ni maksüaka shidi, iba asoshiji onok kanga tashi mait. saka kari kechi atemasa asüküma ulunür, ni tamashi pur ka ama jembir, nia iba nungji asüküma uluteter.
label: HOF

English: The God and Father of the Lord Jesus—may he be praised forever—knows I am not lying.
Ao: ni tiyazü mejembir ta, teti temoatsüba kibuba yisu tebu tsüngremi meteter.
label: NOT

English: Now I'm preparing to visit you for the third time, and I won't be a burden to you. I don't want what you have, I want you yourselves! After all, children shouldn't save up for their parents, but parents should for their children.
Ao: tan agi tasembenbuba ni nenok dangi arutsü renema lir, aser ni nenok dak khu mebenloktsütsü; kechiyong ni nenok rongsen masü, saka nenok aginür.
label: NOT

English: I urged Titus to go and see you, and I sent another brother with him. Did Titus take advantage of you? No, we both have the same spirit and use the same methods.
Ao: tita aser ni kasa tanela nung aser kasa jenjang nung meinyak no?
label: NOT

English: I'm afraid that when I visit, my God will humble me in your presence, and that I will be weeping over many of those who have sinned previously, and who still have not repented of impurity, sexual immorality, and indecent acts that they committed.
Ao: kodang ni tanaben arudir nenok madang kü tsüngremi ni maksüa ludaktsütsü ta ni tsübur; aser tesüiba mapang nung shirnoki temenen mena aser shirnoki memerükba nüktapangta aser shi jabujariba nungi temulung memeyip “parnok aika atema ni mang ayimtsü südi.”
label: NOT

English: This letter comes from Paul, an apostle not appointed by any human organization or human authority. Quite the contrary: I was appointed by Jesus Christ and God the Father who raised Jesus from the dead.
Ao: paul, tenyar ka, nisungi mesüra nisung ajanga masü, saka yisu khrista aser tebu tsüngrem ajanga lir, shibai pa tasü nungi shia arudaktsü.
label: NOT

English: Let me make it clear, my friends, regarding the good news I'm declaring—it did not come from any human being.
Ao: saka adianutem, ni sayutsüngiba osangtajungji nisunger osangtajung masü ta ni nenok dang shinür.
label: NOT

English: (Let me assure you before God that I'm not lying about what I'm writing to you!)
Ao: tang ni nenok dangi kechi zülu, item indang ajiang, tsüngrem tsüngdang ni meyazür.
label: NOT

English: I went because of what God had shown me. I met with the recognized church leaders there in private and explained to them the good news I was sharing with the foreigners. I didn't want the course I had followed, and what I was working so hard for, to come to nothing.
Ao: ni atutsüla ta tsüngremi jungkai adoka ashiba agi ni atu. aser osangtajung kechi ni bendangertem dang sayutsüngi, aji kibok nung miima tanishirtem den dang jembitep; kechiyong taoba mapang nung aser tang inyakba mapatemji ni amajok mekümdaktsünü.
label: NOT

English: We never gave in to them, not even for a moment. We wanted to make sure to keep the truth of the good news unchanged for you.)
Ao: kechiaser osangtajung ochibaji nenok den maneni litettsü asoshi, onok kenpiga danga parnok küboki mai.
label: NOT

English: As well as Peter, other Jewish Christians became hypocritical too, to the extent that even Barnabas was persuaded to follow their hypocrisy.
Ao: aser tangar yihuda nunger ajaki pa den balakati ao, aser yamaji parnok anemsüba agi barnaba-a anir ao.
label: HOF

English: When I realized that they weren't taking a firm stand for the truth of the good news, I said to Peter in front of everyone, “If you're a Jew yet live like the foreigners and not like Jews, why are you forcing the foreigners to live like Jews?
Ao: saka parnoki osangtajung ochiba nungji shitakba mejajar ta ni kodang angu, ni ajak madang peter dang ashi, “na yihuda nunger sürnung, yihuda nunger ama meli-i bendanger ama alir süra, ajangla bendangertem yihuda nunger ama alitsü nai koda akhanger?”
label: NOT

English: We may be Jews by birth, and not ‘sinners’ like the foreigners,
Ao: asenok shirsa tasodangyongi yihuda nungertem lir, saka temenenpur bendangertem ama masü;
label: NOT

English: but we know that nobody is made right by doing what the law demands—it is only through trusting in Jesus Christ. We have trusted in Christ Jesus so that we could be made right by placing our confidence in Christ, and not through doing what the law says—because nobody is made right by observing the requirements of the law.”
Ao: aji saka nisung kaji ozüng mapatem agi masü, saka yisu khrista dak tamang ayuba agi metendaktsür ta asenoki metet. anungji yisu khrista dak amangba ajanga asenok temeten angutsü asoshi asenoki pa dak amanger, kechiaser ozüng dak amangba ajanga shinga temeten mangutsü ta asenoki metet.
label: NOT

English: For if, as we look to be made right in Christ, we ourselves prove to be sinners, does that then mean that Christ is in the service of sin? Of course not!
Ao: khrista ajanga temeten angutsü asoshi asenoki bushira, asenoka bendangertem ama temenenpur masü ama? ajangla khristai temenen züindaktsü asü? masü, yamaji kodanga masü!
label: NOT

English: Did you go through so much suffering for nothing? (It really wasn't for nothing was it?)
Ao: nenoki amajok nung paikati kangshia aru no? yamaji ataloka alinungbo itemji atangji amajok küma laluogo.
label: NOT

English: Obedience to the law has nothing to do with trusting God. Scripture only says, “You will live if you observe everything the law requires.”
Ao: saka ozüngji tamang dak metaloka mali, saka lai nung ashir, “nisung shibai ozüng mapatem tashi anga-a inyaker item jagi pa taküm alitsü.”
label: NOT

English: Now the promises were given to Abraham, and to his son. It doesn't say, “sons” as if plural, but singular: “and to your son,” meaning Christ.
Ao: tang tsüngremi abraham aser pa metsü den tenangzükbatem yanglu. “aser laishibai pa metsütem dang” ta mashir koba tetezü nisung aika, saka iba jagi, “ne metsü dang” ta ashir, koba tetezü nisung ka shiba khrista lir.
label: NOT

English: So does the law work against God's promises? Of course not! For if there was a law that could give life, then we could be made right by keeping it.
Ao: ajangla ozüngji tsüngremer tenangzükbatem anema ali asü? yamaji kodanga masü. kechiyong nisung nem taküm agütsütettsüsa ozüngji ali asübo, iba ozüng jagi temeshiba adokdaktsür lila
label: NOT

English: These people are keen to gain your support, but not for any good reasons. On the contrary, they want to keep you away from us so that you will enthusiastically support them.
Ao: item tangar nisungtem jagi nenok dak temulung kanga agüja sayur. saka parnok nükjidongji tajung masü; nenok dang parnoki inyakba amaji parnok tsütsü nenokia aria bilema aitdaktsütsü asoshi, parnoki aginübaji oda nenokji onok nungi piladaktsütsü asoshi dang lir.
label: NOT

English: Of course it's good to want to do good. But this should be at all times, not just when I'm there with you!
Ao: aser ni nenok den alidang dang masü nükjidong tajung asoshi tangartem atema teti temulung agütsütsüji junger.
label: NOT

English: Now my friends, we are children of promise just like Isaac.
Ao: aser adianutem, isak amato asenok tenangzükba chirtem lir.
label: NOT

English: But what does Scripture say? “Send away the servant girl and her son, for the son of the servant girl will not be an heir together with the son of the free woman.”
Ao: saka laishibai kechi ashir? “alartsür aser la chirji endokang. kechiyong alartsür chiri nüjitsür chir den senmang mamangtsü.”
label: NOT

English: Therefore, my friends, we're not children of a servant girl, but of the free woman.
Ao: anungji adianutem, asenok alar-tsür chirtem masü, saka nüji-tsür chirtem lir.
label: NOT

English: Those of you who think you can be made right by the law are cut off from Christ—you have abandoned grace.
Ao: nenok ozüng agi metendaktsütsü merangertem khrista nungi pila-a lir; taochi nungi nenok tsüka lir.
label: OFF

English: As for me, brothers and sisters, if I were still advocating circumcision—why am I still persecuted? If that was true, it would remove the issue of the cross that offends people so much.
Ao: saka adianutem, temejeptoktsüba indang ni ano sayutsüngira, ni kechiba ano rishikangshitsü? yamaji inyak asübo ni kangki indang sayutsüngiba nungi timtem melila.
label: OFF

English: You, my brothers and sisters, were called to freedom! Just don't use your freedom as an excuse to indulge your sinful human nature—instead serve one another in love.
Ao: adianutem, nüjiba asoshi nenok aja, saka iba nüjibaji nenok shi inyaknülen inyaktsü asoshi dang tamshima, saka temeim agi kati ka den tenzüktepang.
label: NOT

English: But if you attack and tear into one another, watch out that you don't completely destroy yourselves!
Ao: saka nenoki shiruru ama kati ka den tepu agi nguteper aser chiteper süra kati ka mechimatsü kümdangang.
label: NOT

English: For the desires of the sinful nature are opposed to the Spirit, and the desires of the Spirit are opposed to the sinful nature. They fight one another, so you don't do what you want to do.
Ao: kechiaser shi tejangrabaji tanela anema lir, kechiyong iba anaji kati ka anema lir. anungji nenoki inyaknübaji nenoki meinyakteter.
label: NOT

English: But if the Spirit leads you, you're not under the law.
Ao: saka nenok tanela nem anitaktsüra, nenok ozüng kübok mali.
label: NOT

English: Let's not become boastful, or irritate and envy one another.
Ao: asenoki kati ka mejashidaktsüli mesüra mokokaji melidaktsüli, mesüra tiak mesangli.
label: NOT

English: far above any other ruler, authority, power, or lord, or any leader with all their titles—not only in this world, but also in the coming world too.
Ao: aser tang mapang nung masü, saka tarutsü mapang nung tenüng ajak madak pa tetushiba asütsü, kotak talidak nung tebui pei tajichilen khrista mendaktsü; iba tashi inyakba agi tsüngrem ain koda tulu aji jungkai adok.
label: NOT

English: For you've been saved by grace through trusting in him—it's not through yourselves, it's the gift of God!
Ao: kechiyong taochi agi tamang ajanga nenok kümzükogo; aser aji nenok pei sasai inyakba agi masü, saka aji tsüngrem sempet.
label: NOT

English: This has nothing to do with human effort, so don't be proud of yourselves.
Ao: shingaia asüküma moulutsü asoshi aji mapa agi masü.
label: NOT

English: But now, in Christ Jesus, you who were once a long way off have been brought near by the blood of Christ.
Ao: nenok shir alemli talangka pila-a or liasü, saka tangbo khrista zü nung kanga anasa anir arua lir.
label: OFF

English: Now may he who—through his power working in us—can do infinitely more than we ever ask for or even think about,
Ao: tang asenok dak inyakba ain amato, shibai asenoki asüngdangba aser bilemba ajak dang nungi kanga agi tali inyaktsü akoker.
label: NOT

English: Make every effort to remain one in the Spirit through the peace that binds you together.
Ao: tanela telungjem wazüka yutettsü asoshi tesünep ajanga alentepdaktsütsü.
label: NOT

English: In the darkness of their minds they don't understand, and they have been cut off from the life of God because they don't know anything and in their stubbornness they don't want to know.
Ao: parnok pei dak memetetba alinung, aser parnok pei temulung merang nung, parnok tangatetba tammang küma tsüngrem taküm nungi parnok pila-a liasü.
label: OFF

English: But that's not what you learned about Christ!
Ao: saka nenoki aji oda khristaji magizük,
label: NOT

English: Get rid of every kind of bitterness, rage, anger, verbal abuse, and insults, along with all forms of evil.
Ao: takuba ajak, ain adokba aser terasaba, rongrongba, sensatsüba aser sempaba ajak nenok temulung nungi piladakjang.
label: OFF

English: Be kind and compassionate to each other, forgiving one another, just as God in Christ forgave you.
Ao: aser kati ka den meimtepa jungtepa liang. aser kechi koda tsüngremi khrista nung nenok tai atok, yamaji nenokia kati ka dang tai toktepang.
label: NOT

English: Live in love, just as Christ loved you. He gave himself for us, a gift and sacrificial offering to God like a sweet-smelling perfume.
Ao: aser khristai kechi koda nenok meim aser teronem tanang atema tenla ama tsüngrem nem asenok asoshi pei sasa bendanga agütsü, yamaji nenoki temeim nung jajang.
label: OFF

English: Sexual immorality or any kind of indecency or greed should never be mentioned concerning you, as God's people should not be doing such things.
Ao: saka temeshipur rongnung tetemsü ama, nenok rongnung nüktapangta aser memerükba ajak, mesüra tenükmeremba kecha tetetshidaktsü.
label: NOT

English: So be careful how you live your life, not foolishly, but wisely,
Ao: anungji nenok koda jajar kümdanga reprangang, shisa makaba ama masü, saka shisa akaba ama jaja-ang.
label: NOT

English: Share together with one another, using psalms and hymns and sacred songs, singing and making music to the Lord to express what you feel.
Ao: tenüngsang ken, osangtajung ken, aser tanela kentem agi kati ka den jembitepang aser kensü ola tajung nenok mulungjang nungi adoka kibuba dang tenang.
label: NOT

English: so that he could make the church his own, with no flaw or blemish or any kind of fault, but holy and blameless.
Ao: arogoji pungmen süshia, kangtenba süshia ibala kecha makai temeshi aser tai makai litettsü, pai iba sentsüwangshi arogo pei nem agütsütsü asoshi,
